summary: BETSE (BSD-2-Clause, PyPI 1.5.0) is an open implementation of channel and gap-junction dynamics, so the in silico reading is testable, but I did not verify a configuration showing multistability, and BioModels searches found only a few bistable or coupled membrane models. No public in vivo time series of a bioelectric switch exists in what I searched.
next_step: Run a BETSE or BioModels (Bertram2004) bistability scan under fixed parameters; for the tissue reading, a data test needs lab-held voltage-dye time series (none public).
obstacles_confirmed: No public time series records an in vivo bioelectric switch and the subsequent attractor.
A multistable model does not show that tissues occupy those attractors.
